orgs.name: BEM UNJ
orgs.notes: University-wide student executive body. Handle is stable across yearly cabinet rotation (currently 'BEM UNJ 2026'). Email bemunjmail@gmail.com.

orgs.name: MTM UNJ (Majelis Tinggi Mahasiswa)
orgs.notes: University legislative body; at UNJ the legislature is named MTM (Majelis Tinggi Mahasiswa), part of OPMAWA.

orgs.name: BEM FIP UNJ (Ilmu Pendidikan)
orgs.notes: Faculty of Education executive body; Kabinet Kelapa Muda.

orgs.name: BEM FBS UNJ (Bahasa dan Seni)
orgs.notes: Faculty of Languages and Arts executive body.

orgs.name: BEM FMIPA UNJ (Matematika dan IPA)
orgs.notes: Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences executive body. Corroborated by linktr.ee/BEMFMIPAUNJ.

orgs.name: BEM FISH UNJ (Ilmu Sosial dan Hukum)
orgs.notes: Faculty of Social Sciences and Law executive body (formerly FIS).

orgs.name: BEM FIKK UNJ (Ilmu Keolahragaan dan Kesehatan)
orgs.notes: Faculty of Sports Science and Health executive body - relevant to sports/running outreach.

orgs.name: BEM FEB UNJ (Ekonomi dan Bisnis)
orgs.notes: Faculty of Economics and Business executive body. Website bemfeunj.com.

orgs.name: BEM FPPsi UNJ (Pendidikan Psikologi)
orgs.notes: Faculty of Educational Psychology executive body; Kabinet Daksha Pragati.

orgs.name: BPM FISH UNJ (Badan Perwakilan Mahasiswa)
orgs.notes: Faculty-level legislative/representative body for FISH. UNJ uses 'BPM' for faculty legislative bodies.

orgs.name: UKO Mahasiswa UNJ (Unit Kegiatan Olahraga)
orgs.notes: University sports UKM / umbrella body; bio states it oversees 38 sports clubs at UNJ (incl. athletics). PRIORITY sports contact.

orgs.name: UNJ Runners
orgs.notes: Running club; bio references Rawamangun Run Club / Stadion Atletik Velodrome. UNJ affiliation implied by name/location, not explicit in bio - reconfirm at outreach.
